title: Aegis ERP
description: Enterprise order management system with Flutter mobile app, React admin and superadmin dashboards.
Node.js/Express backend with Prisma ORM, PostgreSQL, Redis, and an Electron-based Tally Agent desktop app.
Deployed on Docker Compose with Nginx, monitored via Grafana, Prometheus, and Loki.

title: Dr. Chatur
description: Healthcare platform with a Flutter mobile app, React admin panel, and an Express.js backend.
Integrated Razorpay for payments, Firebase Cloud Messaging for notifications, and AWS S3 for media storage.
Built with Prisma on PostgreSQL, Redis + BullMQ for job queues, and Docker Compose + Docker Swarm for deployment.

title: Novara
description: Full-stack e-commerce platform with a React + Vite frontend and Node.js/Express backend.
Prisma ORM with MySQL for data management, and Redis for caching.
Fully Dockerised dev environment managed via a custom shell script for consistent workflows.

title: Arrow Out
description: 2D/3D game built with Unity using C# scripting, focused on clean scene architecture.
Designed and developed core game mechanics, player input systems using Unity's Input System.
Emphasised reusable component design and performance-friendly asset management.

title: Nexus
description: Developer desktop workspace to manage WebGL builds, Flutter projects, Docker containers, and SSH connections.
Built with Electron and Vite, with a companion landing page deployed to Vercel.
Automated cross-platform releases (macOS, Windows, Linux) via GitHub Actions and Vercel Blob Storage.
